definitions.name: explicit local diagnosis bypasses cloud credentials and Claude authentication and keeps JSON output singular

Source actual config.anthropicKey is tagged undefined. Native saved API mode has no credentials, env_clear supplies none, read_config verifies anthropic_key=None and actual local requests have no authorization/x-api-key headers.
Source actual config.jevKey is tagged undefined; native Option key is None with no environment credentials and only allowlisted local evaluator requests.
Native source-model variants use exact tev1:0.8b in saved settings, report.evaluator_model and every show/systemone request. Supplemental team/router:doctor-v2 variants prove custom model forwarding.

Source startup/case_complete callback progress is suppressed and lines.length=1. Native actual startup and all six packaged cases complete; stdout is one newline-terminated JSON despite internal progress, with empty stderr.

Original source asserts exact passthrough of injected four-field report {schema_version,type,passed,gates:{accuracy:false}}. Native private executable doctor has no injected diagnosticRunner parameter and executes real bounded mock diagnosis. It emits the whole actual report, retained raw; no fields/times removed to fabricate literal equality. Root per-assertion migration review is recorded separately.

definitions.name: local diagnosis rejects the cloud backend without requests and caller cancellation propagates

assertions.expression:
assert.equal(await doctor({ env, evaluateLocal: true, json: true, write: line => lines.push(line),
    run: () => assert.fail('No Claude subprocess'), diagnosticRunner: () => assert.fail('No inference') }), false)
assertions.meaningful_obligation_and_evidence: Source cloud-local branch returns false. Native both no-Claude and sentinel cloud variants return exit1 and a single complete failure JSON object with empty stderr.
Original run fail guard never executes; captured builtin execFile/spawnSync zero. Both native cloud variants have zero HTTP requests, no Claude marker and unchanged isolated saved file set.
Source injected diagnostic runner fail guard has zero calls; native cloud rejection occurs before NativeHttpClient creation or diagnosis and both configured evaluator URLs see zero requests.

Both native cloud stdout JSON bytes equal the complete captured Source JSON string plus the explicit CLI newline. configuration_error code/message/schema/type/false result all match; no object fields normalized.

assertions.expression:
assert.rejects(doctor({ env, evaluateLocal: true, write: () => {}, signal: controller.signal,
    diagnosticRunner: async () => { controller.abort(reason); throw reason; } }), error => error === reason)
assertions.meaningful_obligation_and_evidence: Original caller Error(Diagnostic cancelled) is observed identical through runner, AbortSignal.reason and actual doctor rejection, and original identity predicate passes. Native OS signal/CancellationToken has no reason-object payload and surfaces Evaluation cancelled through exit1/stderr. Eight actual dispatcher stalls prove cancellation is an error with no final configuration_error/report, connection closes and no later request. Literal Error identity/message equality remains an explicit language/executable migration with root per-assertion migration review recorded separately.
assertions.migration_review: Root accepts the cancellation-interface migration for this exact predicate. Source preserves the caller Error object through AbortSignal.reason and rejection; native CancellationToken/OS signal carries cancellation state without a caller Error object. Actual native CLI tests prove error propagation, exit1 and safe cancellation diagnostic, no final configuration_error/report, observed connection release and no subsequent work. Source identity/message remain recorded distinctly; hosts retain their own reason alongside the token.

migration_review.decision: Root accepts the cancellation-interface migration for this exact predicate. Source preserves the caller Error object through AbortSignal.reason and rejection; native CancellationToken/OS signal carries cancellation state without a caller Error object. Actual native CLI tests prove error propagation, exit1 and safe cancellation diagnostic, no final configuration_error/report, observed connection release and no subsequent work. Source identity/message remain recorded distinctly; hosts retain their own reason alongside the token.

native_scenarios.progress_suppression: Five actual complete diagnostic reports emit exactly one JSON line; four canceled JSON variants emit none and text emits only the exact two progress lines.
native_scenarios.provider_wire_bytes: All actual allowlisted synthetic request body/header/method/path and response planned/actual bytes are retained privately. The original Source injected runner makes no HTTP request; do not claim native168 calls equal the original Source0.
